negative_mutations.r5_credit_rejection: All R5 negative executions obtain both the stimulus selector and the defect selector from c.ID; this violates the frozen decisive requirement that results not derive from ID/category/text/digest.

survivor_groups.reason: R5 provides ID-selected switch branches, not an ID-independent executable binding from each declared mutation to a compiled variant; previous finite identity, retry, validation and quota witnesses remain incomplete.

The R5 local subject differs under named switches, but the selection is c.ID and the scenarios remain narrower than the complete declared publication, CAS, progress, race, recovery, shutdown and orphan stimuli.

Real tempdirs and filesystem syscalls are present, but M46 tests only after-rename, M47 only during-write and M48 only after-rename despite declarations requiring every write/fsync/rename/publication boundary; all defects are selected from c.ID.

Privacy, projection, JSON, layering, permission and lookup differences are hard-wired to the case ID. M55/M56 parse distinct fixture packages selected by defect non-emptiness rather than compiling one substitute with a semantically bound mutation.

unknown_policy_audit.negative_unknown_treatment: Any missing, metadata-selected or causally ambiguous negative witness is SURVIVED.

r5_black_box_audit.finding: executeCase calls observeMutation(t, c.ID, empty) for the reference and observeMutation(t, c.ID, c.ID) for the mutant. observeMutation switches directly on id, while runtimeSubject contains 70 comparisons against defect strings Mxx; M55/M56 select mutant fixtures whenever the defect string is nonempty.
r5_black_box_audit.text_binding_finding: Mutation, stimulus and witness are hashed only into stableWitness after observations. Swapping their text between cases would alter the evidence digest but would leave the selected stimulus, defect and Violated verdict unchanged.
r5_black_box_audit.positive_finding: positiveControl is also selected by the Pxx ID. Several controls exercise reduced scenarios rather than their declared concurrent/reopen/full-surface stimuli, so preservation is credited from the independent frozen suites and explicit predecessor run, not from R5 alone.
r5_black_box_audit.disk_finding: The substitute calls OpenFile(O_EXCL), Write, file Sync, Rename, directory Sync and real symlink/hardlink/FIFO syscalls. Its crash stimuli nevertheless cover one chosen point per M46-M48 instead of every declared prefix and select each faulty path from the case ID.
r5_black_box_audit.conclusion: R5 is an executable mutation switchboard, but not an ID-independent binding of adversarial obligations to compiled reference/mutant variants. Its passing result cannot establish integral causal discrimination.
